I have verified the relevant source. Here are my findings.

FINDINGS: [{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#tokenize","claim":"tokenize lowercases, splits on non-alphanumeric/underscore, keeps tokens longer than 2 chars, and drops a STOP set of common words","evidence":"src/db.mjs:224"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#idfRank","claim":"idfRank scores each entry as the sum of IDF weights (log(1+N/df)) of query tokens present in the entry, keeps score>0, sorts descending, and slices to limit","evidence":"src/db.mjs:229-238"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#getLessons","claim":"getLessons ranks non-pass attempts across plans using idfRank over step_title+what_tried+result, excluding the step's own attempts and (unless all=true) other projects","evidence":"src/db.mjs:763-787"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#getLessons","claim":"when step_id is given, getLessons appends the step's title and tools to the query terms and scopes to that step's project","evidence":"src/db.mjs:766-769"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#getLessons","claim":"getLessons tie-breaks equal scores by created_at descending (newer first)","evidence":"src/db.mjs:780"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#recall","claim":"recall builds a single ranked index of plan, step, attempt, and active finding docs (each with a concatenated text field) and ranks them with the same idfRank","evidence":"src/db.mjs:1071-1101"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#recall","claim":"recall only includes findings with status 'active', and surfaces findings with non-empty conflicts_with as status 'conflict'","evidence":"src/db.mjs:1087-1090"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#currentProjectId","claim":"project scoping defaults to the settings key 'current_project' (or 1 if unset), and NULL project_id is treated as project 1 in both recall and getLessons","evidence":"src/db.mjs:417-420, src/db.mjs:777, src/db.mjs:1075"}] 

VERDICT: pass — verified Store.recall and Store.getLessons in src/db.mjs: both use the shared tokenize + idfRank lexical ranker, with getLessons ranking non-pass attempts (excluding own step, project-scoped, newest-first tie-break) and recall ranking plans/steps/attempts/active findings across the project.
